editorial:
Imagine you are driving through the middle of nowhere in Florida and your car breaks down. That is exactly what happens to Reagan, a track star who quickly learns that not every friendly stranger is actually nice. You get pulled into a scary situation when two men kidnap her and lock her up in a lonely cabin. The vibe is pure survival horror, and you will feel the tension as Reagan tries to find any way possible to get away from these crazy people. It is a classic cat-and-mouse game where the roles flip, and you will be rooting for her to use her athletic skills to outrun her captors.

What really works here is how the movie turns Reagan from a victim into a fighter. The action is gritty, and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While the plot is pretty simple, the scares are effective. If you love movies where a strong lead fights back, you will enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a late-night movie session with friends.
endingExplained: After a brutal fight for survival, Reagan manages to turn the tables on her kidnappers. She uses her speed and the environment to fight back against the sociopaths. In the final showdown, she manages to kill the men who captured her, ensuring they can never hurt anyone else. She eventually makes it out of the woods alive, though she is scarred by the experience. It ends with her finally escaping the nightmare and finding safety.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and seeing the bad guys lose.
